format_variation: laboratory skid with accessory feed pump
expected_behavior: Water-treatment laboratory equipment is primary; feed-pump language is accessory context. No pump standard should be promoted as the procurement primary.
source_text_for_pdf: Supply a laboratory ultrapure-water skid with reverse-osmosis membranes, UV oxidation, resistivity monitor, TOC analyzer and automatic sanitization. A small feed pump is included inside the skid as a replaceable accessory. Provide calibration certificates, validation protocol and one-year consumables.
